# Contrast poster — Style Prompt

> A contemporary poster that hits on every cut. Each scene is one flat ground colour (dark, then the brand's main colour, then paper), and five vertical slats of the next colour sweep it away. Huge heavy type hangs on an 80 px left margin and falls in letter by letter through its own mask, the lower line waiting in the line above and colliding with the one landing; stroke-only echoes slide off above and below and fade. The key count flips to the accent, list words are slammed in from alternating sides, a giant figure rolls on odometer columns, and two slanted tapes run across the top and bottom the whole time. Then it holds dead still.

## 1. Essence, and what it is not

The look is **impact and rhythm**: a chapter number you could read from across a room, words that land like stamps, a ground colour that changes with every idea. It is built for the first three seconds of a video, chapter titles, one quotable line and the number that matters. Everything is flat colour and type: solid blocks, a 3 px rule, two tapes, two colour dots. Motion is fast in (0.4-0.6 s, expo) and then completely still; only the tapes keep running.

Not a whole long video (it tires the eye: use it for hooks, chapters and the ending). Not shadows, gradients, glows, blur-ins or textures: only solid colour. Not soft or bouncy (no overshoot, no springs). Not centred: every block hangs on the left margin. Not the same transition three times in a row: about half the cuts can be hard cuts on the same ground.

## 2. Materials & rendering

- **Grounds**: full-frame flat colour, one per scene. The palette has four: dark (#111111), the main colour (an acid lime, #D7FF3A), warm paper (#F3EEE4) and a spare accent blue (#2B50FF). The example uses the first three in that order; the blue is a fourth ground for a longer sequence (paper ink on it, main colour for its emphasis).
- **Slats**: five vertical bands (216 px each, full height) in the next ground's colour, the only moment two grounds share the frame.
- **Tapes**: two bands 76 px tall overhanging 200 px on each side: the top one at y 190 rotated −7°, the bottom one at y 1720 rotated +5°. Filled with the ground's tape colour, mono capitals at 34 px with 0.12em tracking, short phrases separated by asterisks. They sit above the content (a rising echo may pass under the top tape) and under the slats. They are never clipped: the text simply runs off screen.
- **Echoes**: stroke-only copies of a big block (2 px stroke in the ground's ink, transparent fill) at 32% opacity, only for type of 100 px and more.
- **Rule**: 3 px, the ground's ink at 85%, the full 920 px measure, under the chapter title.
- **Tag**: a block at bottom 300 px on every ground: a mono series label (22 px, tracking 0.2em), the name in display type (54 px) with a small second name (34 px, muted), and two 34 px colour dots (the ground's ink, then the next colour) with a 1 px ring.
- Nothing else: no textures, no grain, no rounded cards, no icons.

## 3. Colour logic

Each ground carries its own ink, tape and emphasis, so emphasis never matches its ground.

| Ground | Fill | Ink | Secondary | Tapes | Emphasis |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Dark | `--latar` | `--teks` | `--teks-redup` | `--utama` with `--teks-di-utama` | the chapter number in `--utama-di-latar`; an accent word in `--aksen-di-latar` |
| Main | `--utama` | `--teks-di-utama` | ink 75% into `--utama` (the main-colour pair is only sure of 4.5:1, so its grey stays dark) | `--aksen` with `--teks-di-aksen` | the key glyph in `--aksen` with a 2 px `--teks-di-utama` outline |
| Paper | `--kertas` (= `--teks`) | `--tinta` (= `--latar`) | ink 58% into paper | `--aksen` with `--teks-di-aksen` | a mini-tape: `--aksen` fill behind the words, `--teks-di-aksen` text |

- **Paper is the inversion** of the dark ground: the text colour becomes the ground and the background colour becomes the ink. In its own colours that is the warm paper with black ink; a pale brand turns its third ground near-black, which keeps the poster's light-dark rhythm, and the pair always reads because the contract guarantees `--teks` on `--latar`.
- The outline on the main ground and the mini-tape on paper exist because a brand's accent can sit close to its main colour or its paper (a yellow accent on cream): both stay readable without script.
- Slats take the next ground's fill. Colour dots: ink, then `--utama` (on the main ground, paper).
- `--latar-2` is not part of the frame; keep it for a rare panel on the dark ground.
- Fixed in every brand: nothing but the logic itself. No gradients, no shadows, no tints beyond the secondary mixes (75% on the main colour, 58% on paper) and the 85% rule.

## 4. Type

- `--font-judul` carries every word block: the chapter title at 150 px (line height 0.95), the head at 118 px (1.05), list words at 70 px (1.1), the unit line at 96 px, the tag name at 54 px; tracking −0.02em. It is **slanted 9°** (`skewX(-9deg)`, origin bottom-left, applied per line so lines keep their left edge), standing in for a heavy oblique poster face. Default Archivo Black; Inter 800, Poppins 800 and Oswald 700 also suit, Bebas Neue at 1.2× size.
- `--font-angka` (look token, upright Archivo Black) carries the big numbers: the chapter number at 320 px (0.9, tracking −0.04em) and the figure at 330 px (0.9, tracking −0.05em), its unit or sign as a superscript at 0.42em.
- `--font-kode` (IBM Plex Mono 600, capitals): labels 26 px tracking 0.2em, list indices 30 px, the tag's series label 22 px, tapes 34 px.
- `--font-isi` (Inter 600) carries the one plain line, the note under a figure, at 44 px.
- Keep lines short so a wider brand font still fits 920 px: a chapter title ≤ 8 characters a line, a head ≤ 11, list words ≤ 18, a figure ≤ 4 digits plus a short sign.

## 5. Motion quality

- **Eases**: enter `expo.out`, exit `expo.in`, snap `expo.inOut`, no overshoot anywhere.
- **Collision drop**: a block's letters start at `yPercent: -125` inside **one mask for the whole block** and fall to 0 in 0.6 s `expo.out`, staggered `min(0.045, 0.4 / (n − 1))` s so any block is in within 1 s. Because the mask spans every line, the letters of a lower line wait, visible, in the line above and fall through it while the top line lands: for a moment the two collide. That collision is the look.
- **Echoes**: 0.12 s after the drop starts (the second 0.05 s later) two outline copies go from 0 to 32% opacity while sliding ±92% of the block's height in 0.72 s `expo.out`; at +1.3 s they fade over 0.4 s.
- **Rule and label**: the rule draws from the left (`scaleX` 0 → 1, 0.5 s `expo.out`) about 0.4 s after the title; the mono label drops about 0.45 s later.
- **Recolour**: on the key word, one glyph (or one word) takes its emphasis colour and scales 1.25 → 1 in 0.3 s `expo.out`.
- **Slam alternate**: list words slide from `xPercent` −110, +110, −110 (left, right, left) to 0 in 0.42 s `expo.out`, 0.38-0.4 s apart, and settle 1.08 → 1 over 0.2 s as they land.
- **Odometer**: every digit is a column of 0-9 running past its value once, clipped to 0.9em; columns roll to their digit in `expo.out` over 1.1 s plus 0.15 s per position (so the last digit locks last); the figure fades in over 0.15 s.
- **Ground slats**: five slats of the next ground rise `yPercent` 100 → 0 in 0.38 s `expo.in`, 0.04 s apart from the left; the frame is covered 0.54 s after the start, the scene swaps under them, and they leave upward the same way (`expo.out`). The new scene's words start 0.1-0.5 s after cover.
- **Holds**: after the last move a scene holds still: about 3 s on a list, at least 2 s on the ending. The tapes never stop: 600 px over the whole video, `ease: none`, in opposite directions.
- **Measured rhythm** (15 s reference): hook 3.5 s including its slats, list 5.7 s, ending 5.2 s; while a scene builds, one hit about every 0.4 s, then nothing.

## 6. Camera grammar

The camera is locked: the poster does not move, its type does.

| Move | What it expresses | Can serve |
|---|---|---|
| Locked frame (default) | a printed poster; attention on the words | every beat |
| Punch: the scene's content scales 1.12 → 1 in 0.27 s (8 frames) `power2.out` | a hit: the word or figure lands | the emphasised count, a price, a quotable word; once per scene at most |
| Ground slats | a new chapter, a new idea | between beats, not three times in a row |
| Hard cut on the same ground | the same idea continues | a second line, the next item |
| Tape drift (600 px over the video) | the poster is alive | always, under every hold |

## 7. Native moves

- **Collision drop.** A two-line block falls in through one mask: the lower line's letters wait in the line above and fall through it as the top line lands. *Fits content like:* "Catur / 3 Menit" for a blitz chess tournament; "Kelas / Malam" for a night class opening; a creator's episode title "Gaji / Pertama"; the first line of a short story, "Hujan / Terakhir".
- **Outline echo.** Two stroke-only copies of a big block slide off above and below at 32% and fade after a second. *Fits content like:* a giant chapter number; a shop's one-word promise ("Kilat"); a podcast's episode number; a teacher's lesson title.
- **Ground slats.** Five slats of the next colour sweep up and carry the new scene: dark, main colour, paper. *Fits content like:* rule → list → prize of an event; problem → method → result of a tutorial; a creator's three acts; morning, noon and night of a story.
- **Recolour the count.** On the key word one glyph turns to the accent and bumps from 1.25. *Fits content like:* "Cuma ada 3 aturan"; "5 menu andalan" of a food stall; "2 kesalahan" a coach corrects; "1 rahasia" in a mystery teaser.
- **Slam alternate.** List words hit in from left, right, left, each landing with a small settle. *Fits content like:* three rules of a tournament; three services of a barbershop; three steps of a study method; three clues in a story.
- **Odometer figure.** A giant figure at the lower left rolls its digit columns and locks digit by digit; the unit drops beneath, a short note under it. *Fits content like:* "12,5jt" total prize; "4,9" store rating; "92%" of students passing; "300" days a creator has posted.
- **Contact as tape.** The note's key words light up as a small accent tape, echoing the big tapes. *Fits content like:* a chat number; a class's start date; a channel handle; "bab 2 besok".
- **Running tapes.** Two slanted tapes with the event's words scroll in opposite directions across the top and bottom of every scene. *Fits content like:* a tournament's name and format; a sale's dates; a series and episode; a book club's title.

## 8. Pitfalls

- **Emphasis on its own ground.** Never colour a word in the ground's own colour; use the ground table. Small text on the main ground or paper is never plain accent: use the outline (big glyphs) or the mini-tape (small words).
- **Seek safety.** Build the echoes from the original markup before splitting into letters (a clone made after the first `fromTo` copies the letters' hidden start state). Give recolour and punch `immediateRender: false`, or the key glyph sits at 1.25 before its moment. Roll the odometer by `yPercent`, not measured pixels.
- **Transforms.** Put the 9° slant on an element the timeline never tweens (the line, the word's span), never on the element that slides or scales.
- **Performance.** Do not clip a rotated tape with `overflow: hidden` while its text moves: measured at about 15 fps lost on a slow phone. Let the text run off screen instead. Echoes only for ≥ 100 px type; scenes off screen and used slats hidden with `autoAlpha: 0`.
- **Length.** A wider brand font wraps sooner: shorten the words, do not shrink below 110 px for heads or 64 px for list words.
- **Safe zones.** Information lives between y 340 and 1360 plus the tag; the tapes in the top 250 px and above the bottom 420 px are decoration only, so never put the only copy of a fact on a tape.
- **Fatigue.** Do not run this look for a whole minute; it is the hook, the chapter cards and the ending of a longer video.

## Variation space

From the source's layouts, all on the 80 px margin: the chapter number on top with the title at the bottom (default), centred, at the top, or low on the left; the list under a head at the top (default), centred, or low; the figure low on the left (default), centred or top left. A fourth ground in the accent blue with paper ink and main-colour emphasis extends the cycle. About half the cuts may be hard cuts so the slats stay special.

# Contrast poster: beat plan

Default length 15 s. Tempo per beat (seconds): short 2.4, medium 3.5, long 5.

## hook

- en: a giant chapter number and a two-line title drop letter by letter on the dark ground, outline echoes sliding off above and below
- id: nomor bab raksasa dan judul dua baris jatuh huruf per huruf di tanah gelap, gema garis tepi meluncur ke atas dan bawah

## problem

- en: the pain in one huge cropped line dropping in; its worst word flips to the accent colour and the frame punches 12%
- id: masalahnya satu baris raksasa yang jatuh masuk; kata terparahnya berganti warna aksen dan layar menghentak 12%

## fact

- en: slats bring a new ground; one short line drops in big with outline echoes, a small mono label above it
- id: bilah membawa tanah baru; satu baris pendek jatuh besar dengan gema garis tepi, label mono kecil di atasnya

## step

- en: title on top, its count in the accent; each step slams in from alternate sides, left, right, left
- id: judul di atas, jumlahnya warna aksen; tiap langkah dihantam masuk bergantian dari kiri, kanan, kiri

## compare

- en: two words slam in from opposite sides on one ground, then slats cut to the winner on the next colour
- id: dua kata dihantam dari sisi berlawanan di satu tanah, lalu bilah memotong ke pemenangnya di warna berikut

## number

- en: a giant low-left figure rolls on odometer columns to its value; the unit drops under it, small superscript sign
- id: angka raksasa kiri bawah berputar di kolom odometer sampai nilainya; satuannya jatuh di bawah, tanda kecil di atas

## proof

- en: the figure or quote holds big on paper; a source note drops in and its key word lights up as an accent tape
- id: angka atau kutipan diam besar di tanah kertas; catatan sumber jatuh masuk, kata kuncinya menyala jadi pita aksen

## offer

- en: the price rolls on the odometer on the main-colour ground, the offer line drops beneath it
- id: harga berputar di odometer di tanah warna utama, kalimat penawaran jatuh di bawahnya

## cta

- en: slats to paper, the figure rolls, the call line drops, the contact lights up as an accent tape; held 2 s
- id: bilah ke tanah kertas, angka berputar, ajakan jatuh, kontak menyala jadi pita aksen; diam 2 detik

## payoff

- en: back to the dark ground: the closing line drops in giant with echoes, name tag below; held 2 s
- id: kembali ke tanah gelap: kalimat penutup jatuh raksasa dengan gema, label nama di bawah; diam 2 detik

<!doctype html>
<html lang="id">
  <head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8" />
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=1080, height=1920" />
    <title>Poster kontras</title>
    <script src="/_lib/gsap@3.15.1/gsap.min.js"></script>
    <style>
      @font-face { font-family: "Archivo Black"; src: url("data:font/woff2;base64,"); font-weight: 400; }
      @font-face { font-family: "Inter"; src: url("data:font/woff2;base64,"); font-weight: 600; }
      @font-face { font-family: "IBM Plex Mono"; src: url("data:font/woff2;base64,"); font-weight: 600; }
      /* Token brand (recipes/README.md): brand mengganti dua belas nilai pertama. Lime = --utama, biru = --aksen.
         Sesudahnya milik tampilan ini: tanah ketiga adalah kertas (warna teks jadi latar, warna latar jadi tinta),
         huruf angka raksasa dan huruf mono untuk label dan pita. */
      :root {
        --latar: #111111; --latar-2: #1c1c1c; --utama: #d7ff3a; --aksen: #2b50ff;
        --teks: #f3eee4; --teks-redup: #9a958c; --teks-di-utama: #111111;
        --teks-di-aksen: #111111; --utama-di-latar: #d7ff3a; --aksen-di-latar: #6f88ff;
        --font-judul: "Archivo Black", "Noto Sans", sans-serif; --font-isi: "Inter", "Noto Sans", sans-serif;
        --kertas: var(--teks); --tinta: var(--latar);
        --font-angka: "Archivo Black", "Noto Sans", sans-serif; --font-kode: "IBM Plex Mono", monospace;
      }
      * { margin: 0; padding: 0; box-sizing: border-box; }
      html, body { width: 1080px; height: 1920px; overflow: hidden; background: var(--latar); }
      #root { position: relative; width: 100%; height: 100%; overflow: hidden; background: var(--latar);
        font-family: var(--font-isi); -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased; }
      /* Tiap potongan punya tanah sendiri: warna tanah, tinta, pita, dan titik ikut kelasnya */
      .scene { position: absolute; inset: 0; overflow: hidden; background: var(--bg); color: var(--ink); }
      .g1 { --bg: var(--latar); --ink: var(--teks); --mute: var(--teks-redup); --tape: var(--utama);
        --tape-ink: var(--teks-di-utama); --dot: var(--utama); }
      .g2 { --bg: var(--utama); --ink: var(--teks-di-utama); --mute: color-mix(in oklab, var(--teks-di-utama) 75%, var(--utama));
        --tape: var(--aksen); --tape-ink: var(--teks-di-aksen); --dot: var(--kertas); }
      .g3 { --bg: var(--kertas); --ink: var(--tinta); --mute: color-mix(in oklab, var(--tinta) 58%, var(--kertas));
        --tape: var(--aksen); --tape-ink: var(--teks-di-aksen); --dot: var(--utama); }
      .cnt { position: absolute; inset: 0; transform-origin: 50% 45%; }
      /* Huruf jatuh: tiap baris punya mask, gema garis tepi naik dan turun dari baris besar */
      [data-drop] { position: relative; }
      .mask { display: block; overflow: hidden; padding: 0.06em 0 0.12em; margin: -0.06em 0 -0.12em; }
      .ch { display: inline-block; white-space: pre; }
      .echo { position: absolute; left: 0; top: 0; width: 100%; pointer-events: none; }
      .echo, .echo * { color: transparent !important; background: none !important; -webkit-text-stroke: 2px var(--ink); }
      .d { font-family: var(--font-judul); letter-spacing: -0.02em; line-height: 1.04; white-space: nowrap; }
      .sk { transform: skewX(-9deg); transform-origin: 0 100%; }
      .lbl { font-family: var(--font-kode); font-weight: 600; font-size: 26px; letter-spacing: 0.2em; text-transform: uppercase;
        color: var(--mute); white-space: nowrap; }
      em { font-style: normal; display: inline-block; }
      /* Bab terbelah: nomor raksasa di atas, judul di bawah di atas garis */
      .chap { position: absolute; left: 80px; right: 80px; top: 340px; bottom: 560px; display: flex; flex-direction: column;
        justify-content: flex-end; }
      .num { margin-bottom: auto; font-family: var(--font-angka); font-size: 320px; line-height: 0.9; letter-spacing: -0.04em;
        color: var(--utama-di-latar); }
      .chap .ttl { font-size: 150px; line-height: 0.95; }
      .rule { margin-top: 30px; height: 3px; background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--ink) 85%, transparent); transform-origin: 0 50%; }
      .chap .lbl { margin-top: 30px; }
      /* Judul di atas, daftar dihantam bergantian dari kiri dan kanan */
      .head { position: absolute; left: 80px; right: 80px; top: 420px; }
      .head .ttl { margin-top: 20px; font-size: 118px; line-height: 1.05; }
      .g2 em[data-acc] { color: var(--aksen); -webkit-text-stroke: 2px var(--teks-di-utama); }
      .list { position: absolute; left: 80px; right: 80px; top: 1000px; list-style: none; }
      .list li { display: flex; align-items: baseline; gap: 28px; padding: 26px 0; }
      .list b { font-family: var(--font-kode); font-weight: 600; font-size: 30px; min-width: 70px; color: var(--ink); }
      .list .d { display: inline-block; font-size: 70px; line-height: 1.1; }
      /* Angka raksasa kiri bawah: kolom odometer, satuan kecil menempel di atas */
      .stat { position: absolute; left: 80px; right: 80px; bottom: 560px; }
      .val { font-family: var(--font-angka); font-size: 330px; line-height: 0.9; letter-spacing: -0.05em; white-space: nowrap; }
      .val .dg { display: inline-block; vertical-align: top; }
      .val .col { overflow: hidden; height: 0.9em; }
      .val .strip i { display: block; height: 0.9em; font-style: normal; }
      .val::after { content: attr(data-suffix); display: inline-block; vertical-align: top; font-size: 0.42em; letter-spacing: 0;
        margin-left: 0.04em; line-height: 1; padding-top: 0.1em; }
      .unit { margin-top: 18px; font-size: 96px; }
      .note { margin-top: 44px; font-family: var(--font-isi); font-weight: 600; font-size: 44px; white-space: nowrap; }
      .chip { padding: 0 0.16em; margin: 0 -0.16em; }
      .chip[data-acc] { background: var(--aksen); color: var(--teks-di-aksen); margin: 0 0 0 0.1em; }
      /* Pita miring yang terus berjalan, label seri, nama, dua titik warna */
      .tape { position: absolute; left: -200px; right: -200px; height: 76px; display: flex; align-items: center;
        white-space: nowrap; background: var(--tape); color: var(--tape-ink); font-family: var(--font-kode); font-weight: 600;
        font-size: 34px; letter-spacing: 0.12em; z-index: 5; }
      .tape.t1 { top: 190px; transform: rotate(-7deg); }
      .tape.t2 { top: 1720px; transform: rotate(5deg); }
      .run { display: block; white-space: pre; }
      .tag { position: absolute; left: 80px; right: 80px; bottom: 300px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 12px; }
      .tag .k { font-family: var(--font-kode); font-weight: 600; font-size: 22px; letter-spacing: 0.2em; color: var(--mute); }
      .tag .n { font-family: var(--font-judul); font-size: 54px; white-space: nowrap; }
      .tag .n .sk { display: inline-block; }
      .tag small { font-family: var(--font-angka); font-size: 34px; color: var(--mute); margin-left: 16px; }
      .tag .sw { display: flex; gap: 10px; margin-top: 6px; }
      .tag .sw i { width: 34px; height: 34px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--ink);
        box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px color-mix(in oklab, var(--ink) 18%, transparent); }
      .tag .sw i + i { background: var(--dot); }
      /* Bilah tanah baru: lima bilah naik dari bawah, warna tanah berikutnya */
      .slat { position: absolute; top: 0; bottom: 0; width: 217px; background: var(--bg); z-index: 20; }
    </style>
  </head>
  <body>
    <div id="root" data-composition-id="main" data-start="0" data-duration="15" data-width="1080" data-height="1920" data-fps="30">
      <section class="scene g1" id="s1" data-role="hook">
        <div class="cnt">
          <div class="chap">
            <div class="num" data-drop>01</div>
            <div class="ttl d" data-drop><div class="sk">Catur</div><div class="sk">3 Menit</div></div>
            <div class="rule"></div>
            <div class="lbl" data-drop>Turnamen terbuka · Sabtu ini</div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </section>
      <section class="scene g2" id="s2" data-role="step">
        <div class="cnt">
          <div class="head">
            <div class="lbl" data-drop>Aturan main</div>
            <div class="ttl d" data-drop><div class="sk">Cuma ada</div><div class="sk"><em>3</em> aturan</div></div>
          </div>
          <ul class="list">
            <li><b>01</b><span class="d sk">Jam 3 menit</span></li>
            <li><b>02</b><span class="d sk">Sentuh = jalan</span></li>
            <li><b>03</b><span class="d sk">Jam habis · kalah</span></li>
          </ul>
        </div>
      </section>
      <section class="scene g3" id="s3" data-role="cta">
        <div class="cnt">
          <div class="stat">
            <div class="val" data-suffix="jt">12,5</div>
            <div class="unit d" data-drop><div class="sk">Total hadiah</div></div>
            <div class="note" data-drop>Daftar: <em class="chip">Chat 0812-3456-7890</em></div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </section>
    </div>
    <script>
      const R = document.getElementById("root");
      const tl = gsap.timeline({ paused: true });
      const $ = (s, el = R) => el.querySelector(s);
      const $$ = (s, el = R) => [...el.querySelectorAll(s)];
      const add = (host, cls, html) => { const n = document.createElement("div"); n.className = cls; if (html) n.innerHTML = html; host.appendChild(n); return n; };

      // Pita, label seri, dan nama dipasang di tiap potongan (warna ikut tanahnya)
      const TAPE = "CATUR KILAT * 3 MENIT * LIGA PION * TERBUKA * ";
      $$(".scene").forEach((s) => {
